sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite animation expansion for original hand-drawn 2D dark fantasy insect game. Reference images are identity and style references only, NOT desired grid or background. Preserve exact character identity, proportions, costume, palette, clean ink and painterly material textures. Pure side view all living frames facing RIGHT. Transparent real alpha background, no backdrop, ground, shadows, labels, text, borders, particles, panels. Each equal cell contains exactly one COMPLETE character including every antenna, blade and robe, with ample transparent gutter. Fixed body scale and centered pelvis, grounded foot baseline at 90% cell height. Distinct redrawn poses with real limb and weapon articulation, never stamp, shift or rotate a whole copy. Character: Mirrorpool Bride reference, slender ivory moth mask, twig crown with teardrop pendants, layered mirror-silver wing dress with gold filigree, flowing lavender grey veil, long thin obsidian ceremonial needle held in hand. Exactly SIX columns and SIX rows 36 sprites. Same scale every character and complete full length needle fits cell with broad transparent gutters. Read row-major 0-35: 0-3 four breathing idle poses with veil drift; 4-11 eight walking poses with alternating foot contact/down/passing/up and subtle wing counterweight; 12-15 four windup raising needle overhead and drawing elbow back; 16-21 six forward needle thrust poses progressing extension, body lunge, contact and follow-through; 22-27 six graceful retracting recovery poses; 28-31 four backward hurt recoil and crouch; 32-35 four death kneel/falling/low/collapsed. All sprites side view face right, fine clear hand drawn 2D rendering, no background, no effects or particles or shadow, real alpha transparency.

qa.review: Source sheets visually reviewed; independent complete alpha components explicitly selected; merged characters and edge-clipped poses excluded. Source atlas and attacks unchanged.
qa.mechanical_packaging: Component isolation of authored source pixels, scale normalization and atlas packing; no procedural animation or interpolation.
